当王野睁开眼时已经是第二天早上了，出了浴桶，用旁边盆里的水清洗了一下身子，就开始清理浴桶里的废水。

王野双手抱着浴桶，扎紧马步全身发力，一桶水就被王野抱了起来。这个桶加上水得有五百来斤，王野抱着并不是特别吃力。

在王野的大力下，没一会儿就把浴桶清理干净了。这时平三卓也从屋里出来了，看王野在清理浴桶，就说：“小野弄完过来吃饭，吃完饭，我带你去找永宁先生。”

王野说：“师父，我今天还要上班。”

平三卓说：“老赵说了，今天你不用去上班了，他会搞定的。”

王野点头答应后就跟着平三卓进了屋子。

一顿简单的早饭，就是一人一碗大米粥，一个二合面的馒头，一碟小咸菜。唯一不同的是，师娘还给王野煮了一个鸡蛋。

王野看了看手里的鸡蛋，又看了看平三卓，师娘却开口了：“看他干嘛，家里的事儿师娘说了算。”

王野笑嘻嘻的剥着鸡蛋，对着师娘说：“谢谢师娘。”

王野一边吃着饭一边问：“师傅，师娘，我听赵爷爷说，家里应该有大哥二哥呀！怎么我来好几次了一次都没见到呀？”

一提起这个，平三卓脸色立刻就不好了，气鼓鼓的说：“你大哥在市政府工作，他有分配的房子，这个缺德玩意儿离家这么近，好几个月不回来一次。你二哥更别说了，当兵去了，两年没回来过了。”

接下来王野可不敢继续这个话题了，这要是把老头的火气拱上来，说不定老头会去市政机关打老大一顿。

一顿简单的早饭后，平三卓带着王野出了院子，两人东拐西拐到了一处二进的院子前。

平三卓见院门敞开就直接进入院子就喊：“远白在家吗？”

话音刚落，从屋里出来一位中年男子，这男子带着一副眼镜，身穿一身笔挺的中山装，略显灰白的头发梳的一丝不苟。出门看见平三卓，赶紧上前两步说：“是平先生啊，多日不见先生仍是神采奕奕。”

平三卓笑呵呵的说：“远白啊，咱俩就不用客气了，今天我登门是有事相求。”

永宁拱手一礼说：“先生言重了，有什么事您老吩咐就是了，远白自当尽力。”

刚开始王野还被我两人的称呼搞的晕头转向。后来一想才知道“远白”应该是永宁先生的字。平三卓称呼永宁先生的字可见是把他当朋友了，而不是依仗年龄把永宁先生当晚辈儿。

永宁引领着平三卓和王野进入正堂，这个屋子装修风格古朴典雅，注重传统元素运用，木质雕花门窗、挂有书画作品、摆放实木家具。正中央常摆放八仙桌与太师椅，两侧可能有配套座椅，体现庄重与秩序。

平三卓率先开口：“远白，先给你介绍一下，这是我新收的徒弟，王野。”

王野起身行礼，永宁点头微笑算是回礼。

平三卓继续说：“我也不跟你客套，这孩子心境出了点问题，需要修身养性，这不我就想到了你，在这四九城，你永宁先生的美名可算是家喻户晓。”

永宁上下打量了一下王野说：“没想到小兄弟还是江湖中人。”

对于永宁这种传统文化人来说，江湖中人多是大老粗，所以并不是很感冒。平三卓哪能听不出永宁的意思，就说：“现在哪儿还有什么江湖，小野现在在工厂保卫科上班，闲暇时跟我学学医术。”

永宁脸色稍有缓和说：“那就是公门中人了，这也解释得通了。”

永宁虽不是江湖中人，但也知道，心境出问题十有八九是手里沾了人命。

When Wang Ye opened his eyes, it was already the next morning. He got out of the bathtub, washed himself with the water in the basin next to him, and then began to clean up the waste water in the bathtub.

Wang Ye held the bath bucket with both hands, tightened his stance and exerted all his strength. Wang Ye picked up the bucket of water.This bucket plus water weighed about 500 kilograms, and it was not particularly difficult for Wang Ye to hold it.

With Wang Ye's strong efforts, the tub was cleaned in a short time.At this time, Ping Sanzhuo also came out of the room. Seeing Wang Ye cleaning the bathtub, he said, "Xiao Ye, come over and have dinner. After dinner, I will take you to Mr. Yongning."

Wang Ye said: "Master, I have to go to work today."

Ping Sanzhuo said: "Old Zhao said you don't have to go to work today, he will take care of it."

Wang Ye nodded in agreement and followed Ping Sanzhuo into the house.

A simple breakfast is just a bowl of rice porridge per person, a steamed bun with two noodles, and a plate of pickles.The only difference is that the wife also boiled an egg for Wang Ye.

Wang Ye looked at the egg in his hand and then at Ping Sanzhuo, but the master's wife said: "Watch what he does. The master's wife has the final say in matters at home."

Wang Ye peeled the eggs with a smile and said to his wife: "Thank you, my wife."

Wang Ye asked while eating: "Master, Master, I heard from Grandpa Zhao that there should be an eldest brother and a second brother at home! Why haven't I seen him even though I've been here several times?"

When he mentioned this, Ping Sanzhuo's face immediately turned bad, and he said angrily: "Your eldest brother works in the city government, and he is assigned a house. This wicked thing is so close to home, and he hasn't come back for several months. Not to mention your second brother, he went to the army and has not been back for two years."

Wang Ye didn't dare to continue this topic. If this made the old man angry, he might go to the municipal government to beat up the boss.

After a simple breakfast, Ping Sanzhuo took Wang Ye out of the yard, and the two of them turned east and west to a second-entry yard.

When Ping Sanzhuo saw the courtyard door open, he entered the courtyard directly and shouted: "Is Yuan Bai at home?"

As soon as he finished speaking, a middle-aged man came out of the room. This man wore a pair of glasses, a straight tunic suit, and his slightly gray hair was meticulously combed.When I saw Ping Sanzhuo when I went out, I quickly took two steps forward and said, "It's Mr. Ping. He is still in high spirits after not seeing him for many days."

Ping Sanzhuo said with a smile: "Yuanbai, there's no need to be polite. I'm here today to ask for something."

Yongning bowed his hands and said, "Sir, you are serious. If you have anything to do, just give me your instructions. Yuanbai should do his best."

At first, Wang Ye was confused by our names.Later, when I thought about it, I realized that "Yuanbai" should be Mr. Yongning's name.The way Ping Sanzhuo calls Mr. Yongning shows that he regards him as a friend, rather than treating Mr. Yongning as a senior based on his age.

Yongning led Ping Sanzhuo and Wang Ye into the main hall. The decoration style of this house is simple and elegant, focusing on the use of traditional elements, with wooden carved doors and windows, hanging calligraphy and painting works, and solid wood furniture.The Eight Immortals table and the Grand Master's chair are often placed in the center, and there may be matching seats on both sides to reflect solemnity and order.

Ping Sanzhuo was the first to speak: "Yuanbai, let me introduce you first. This is my new disciple, Wang Ye."

Wang Ye stood up and saluted, and Yongning nodded and smiled in return.

Ping Sanzhuo continued: "I won't be polite to you. There is something wrong with this child's state of mind and he needs to cultivate his moral character. Then I thought of you. In these four-nine cities, your reputation as Mr. Yongning is well-known to every household."

Yongning looked Wang Ye up and down and said, "I didn't expect that this little brother is still a member of the world."

For a person with traditional culture like Yongning, most people in the world are old and rough, so they are not very cold.How could Ping Sanzhuo not understand what Yong Ning meant, so he said: "Where is the world now? Xiaoye is working in the security department of the factory, and he will learn medical skills from me in his spare time."

Yongning's expression softened slightly and he said, "That's someone from the public family. That makes sense."

Although Yong Ning is not a member of the martial arts world, he also knows that when someone has a mental problem, there is a high probability that he has someone's life on his hands.
